done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and eligibility is confirmed from the records, not from accounts the customer remembers. Then one of these is true. (1) For ATM-usage needs, the customer agreed to the account with the lowest documented Rho-Bank ATM fees among the classes that meet their early direct deposit need, age and hard needs. (2) For feature needs (no overdraft fees, linked-account overdraft protection, at least 1 day early direct deposit, a fee waiver within the balance they can keep), ONE account meeting all of them was recommended (for an adult outside the Dark Green ages, the Blue Account), and any eco or premium question was answered by naming the need that account does not meet. (3) A checking class the customer accepted earlier was confirmed. After that, open_bank_account_4821 opened the account, and the agent explained its fee and waiver, how the customer enables Blue's overdraft protection ($12.50 per transfer) if they want it, and the payer setup for direct deposit if they need it. Or the customer was told why the account could not be opened, and was transferred only if they agreed after a system error. If the customer also asked to close an old checking account, closing_personal_checking_accounts follows.

steps.do: For every account still in play after filter_hard_needs, limit_filter and the checks in compare, work out the total Rho-Bank ATM fees over the customer's stated usage period. That period runs from the first month of the usage the customer describes through its last month, for the usage_duration months they gave. Total = fee per withdrawal × withdrawals per month × months, with free allowances applied month by month and percentage minimums and caps applied to each withdrawal. Fees (foreign / out-of-network): Green Fee-Free $0.00 / $0.00. Purple $0.00 / $2.50. Bluest $0.00 / $2.00. Blue the greater of 3% or $5.00 / 1% max $3.00. Green (checking) the greater of 3% or $5.00 / $3.00. Evergreen 2% min $3.00 / 1% max $2.50. Light Blue 2 free a month then $4.00 / 2 free a month then $2.50. Dark Green 2.5% max $6.00 / 1% min $1.50. Gold Years $3.50, waived when the account balance is $10,000 or more at the time of the withdrawal / $0.00. Light Green $2.00 up to $100, $3.50 over $100 up to $300, $5.00 above $300 / 4 free a month then $1.50. Third-party operator fees are separate from Rho-Bank's, so they are not in the totals. Bluest rebates them up to $50 a month and Purple up to $30, which you may mention.
